# androidworld/pro-expense

Pro Expense bookkeeping as deterministic hard skills for the AndroidWorld Expense tasks; add expense rows from a list or from a Markor transactions file.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install androidworld/pro-expense
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run androidworld/pro-expense expense_add_multiple --device <serial> --param rows=<rows>
ghost skill run androidworld/pro-expense expense_add_single --device <serial> --param rows=<rows>
ghost skill run androidworld/pro-expense expense_add_multiple_from_markor --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `expense_add_multiple`: Add the following expenses into the pro expense: {rows}
- `expense_add_single`: Add the following expense into the pro expense: {rows}
- `expense_add_multiple_from_markor`: Go through the transactions in my_expenses.txt in Markor. Log the reimbursable transactions in the pro expense.
